item.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=autonomous+system+objective+synthesis+from+ambient+feedback+mechanisms&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.6738378\", \"title\": [\"From Monitoring to Control: A Feedback-Driven Autonomous System for API Workflow Reliability\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Traditional API monitoring systems emphasize observability through anomaly detection and alerting, but fall short in ensuring reliable execution of distributed workflows involving interdependent services, partial failures, and irreversible actions. This paper introduces a novel control-driven paradigm that reframes API monitoring as a closed-loop feedback system for maintaining workflow correctness. Drawing from control theory, we propose a feedback-driven autonomous framework that continuously observes system telemetry, evaluates workflow state consistency, and applies adaptive control actions to mitigate deviations from expected behavior. Unlike existing approaches based on static synthetic tests or reactive anomaly detection, the proposed method models API workflows as dynamic stateful processes and enforces reliability through continuous correction and stabilization. The framework is evaluated using a simulated multi-step transactional system with injected failure scenarios, demonstrating significant improvements in mean time to recovery (MTTR), workflow consistency, and failure resolution effectiveness. The results highlight the potential of control-oriented architectures to transform monitoring from passive observation into active reliability assurance in modern enterprise systems.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.6738378\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.5957001\", \"title\": [\"Optimized Fuzzy Feedback Control for Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Tracking via Adaptive Multi-Objective Differential Evolution\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5957001\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.5957000\", \"title\": [\"Optimized Fuzzy Feedback Control for Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Tracking via Adaptive Multi-Objective Differential Evolution\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.2139/ssrn.5957000\", \"published\": {\"date-par…
